name: Northwest Pipeline Ryckman Creek Lateral Loop
monitor_reason: length: 6.75 mi (about 10.9 km) of new 12-inch pipe is under the 25 km add threshold
researcher_notes: The Williams project page for the Ryckman Creek Lateral Loop Project says Northwest Pipeline will build a 6.75 mile, 12 inch loop parallel to the existing 8 inch Ryckman Creek Lateral in Uinta County, Wyoming. It connects to the Spire Storage facility. It is regulated by FERC under Prior Notice and is expected in service by the fourth quarter of 2026. No existing row under another name was found in the roster; the parent system is the Northwest Gas Pipeline row P0230. The loop adds well under 25 km of new pipe, so it is monitor for length. No second independent source was checked. If a row is ever wanted, use PipelineName Northwest Gas Pipeline and the segment name above. Route not researched.
